title: Version 2 Security, Privacy, and Recovery UI Audit

securityControls: Rendered markdown runs through sanitizeAssistantMarkdown to strip <script>, <iframe>, <object>, and javascript: URIs.
External links enforce target='_blank' and rel='noopener noreferrer' to prevent window.opener tabnabbing.
Tracking pixels (1x1 images) and external unverified image URLs are blocked; only relative workspace assets render.
Direct navigation by unauthenticated or non-operator users returns HTTP 401/403 and renders an access-denied shield.
No tenant data, feedback attachments, or personal journal snippets are prefetched or rendered until operator role is cryptographically established.
Feedback report actions log operator user ID and timestamp to audit log.
Diagnostic payload preview inspects all JSON fields before export.
Authorization tokens, passwords, encryption keys, and personal journal bodies are strictly masked to '[REDACTED]'.
Clear disclosure provided to user before clipboard copy or file download.
Two-factor confirmation required for account and workspace deletion.
Explicit banner explains the 30-day grace period, permanent purge, and deletion suppression tombstone ledger.
Reassures user that restored backups cannot resurrect erased workspaces due to pre-access suppression ledger barrier.
Clear boundary explanation: local disconnect removes stored OAuth tokens and cancels background sync jobs.
Informs user that imported local copies remain in Daynori unless explicitly deleted, and remote Google Drive files are never modified or trashed.
